summary: Footpath in the Botanic Gardens rock garden; no vehicle access, very steep.

drivers.seclusion: Planted garden among the cafe, dome and lake; a public visitor area.
drivers.access_and_room: Ring is on a narrow garden path; no vehicles or tyre tracks, no room to stop a van. The only parking is the visitor car park 76 m away.
drivers.traffic: Footpath visitors by day; no road at the ring.
drivers.convention: No sign anyone parks or stays; gardens are likely closed overnight.

flags: Mapped gates nearby (81 m to 282 m), not on only access
sun_shade: Part shaded by garden trees; open to the sky along the path.
cannot_judge: Overnight rules in the visitor car park
